mapper.select: SELECT operation.id AS operationId, operation.client_id AS clientId, client.display_name AS displayName, operation.operation_type AS action, operation.completed_at AS completedAt, CASE WHEN operation.operation_type IN ('CREATE', 'ROTATE') THEN operation.completed_at + INTERVAL '10 minutes' END AS recoveryUntil, (operation.operation_type IN ('CREATE', 'ROTATE') AND client.client_status = 'ACTIVE' AND client.client_type = 'RUNTIME_SERVICE' AND #{at} BETWEEN operation.completed_at AND operation.completed_at + INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND secret.revoked_at IS NULL AND secret.valid_until IS NULL AND secret.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM iam_oauth_client_management_operations recovery WHERE recovery.original_operation_id = operation.id AND recovery.operation_type = 'RECOVER' AND recovery.outcome = 'SUCCEEDED')) AS canRecover FROM iam_oauth_client_management_operations operation JOIN iam_oauth_clients client ON client.id = operation.client_id LEFT JOIN iam_oauth_client_secrets secret ON secret.id = operation.secret_record_id WHERE operation.actor_identity_id = #{actorIdentityId} AND operation.id < #{beforeId} ORDER BY operation.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT client.id AS clientId, overlap.ends_at AS overlapEndsAt, (client.client_type = 'RUNTIME_SERVICE' AND client.client_status = 'ACTIVE' AND overlap.ends_at IS NULL) AS canRotate, (client.client_type = 'RUNTIME_SERVICE' AND client.client_status = 'ACTIVE') AS canRevoke FROM iam_oauth_clients client LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(valid_until) AS ends_at FROM iam_oauth_client_secrets WHERE client_id = client.id AND revoked_at IS NULL AND valid_until > #{at}) overlap ON TRUE WHERE client.id = #{clientId}

INSERT INTO iam_oauth_clients (display_name, client_type, reserved_service_key, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, updated_at, revoked_at) VALUES (#{row.displayName}, #{row.clientType}, #{row.reservedServiceKey}, #{row.allowedScopes, typeHandler=io.saasforge.iam.infrastructure.persistence.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, #{row.clientStatus}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt}, #{row.revokedAt}) RETURNING id, display_name, client_type, reserved_service_key, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, updated_at, revoked_at

INSERT INTO iam_oauth_clients (id, display_name, client_type, reserved_service_key, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, updated_at, revoked_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.displayName}, #{row.clientType}, #{row.reservedServiceKey}, #{row.allowedScopes, typeHandler=io.saasforge.iam.infrastructure.persistence.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, #{row.clientStatus}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt}, #{row.revokedAt}) RETURNING id, display_name, client_type, reserved_service_key, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, updated_at, revoked_at

INSERT INTO iam_oauth_client_secrets (client_id, secret_digest, created_at, valid_until, revoked_at) VALUES (#{row.clientId}, #{row.secretDigest}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.validUntil}, #{row.revokedAt}) RETURNING id, client_id, secret_digest, created_at, valid_until, revoked_at

SELECT client.id, client.display_name, client.client_type, client.reserved_service_key, client.allowed_scopes, client.client_status, client.created_at, client.updated_at, client.revoked_at FROM iam_oauth_clients client JOIN iam_oauth_client_secrets secret ON secret.client_id = client.id WHERE secret.secret_digest = #{secretDigest} AND client.client_status = 'ACTIVE' AND secret.revoked_at IS NULL AND (secret.valid_until IS NULL OR secret.valid_until > #{at})
SELECT id, display_name, client_type, reserved_service_key, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, updated_at, revoked_at FROM iam_oauth_clients WHERE id = #{clientId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, display_name, client_type, reserved_service_key, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, updated_at, revoked_at FROM iam_oauth_clients WHERE id = #{clientId}

SELECT id, display_name, client_type, reserved_service_key, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, updated_at, revoked_at FROM iam_oauth_clients WHERE client_type = 'RESERVED_SERVICE' AND reserved_service_key = #{serviceKey} AND client_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, display_name, client_type, reserved_service_key, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, updated_at, revoked_at FROM iam_oauth_clients WHERE client_type = 'RESERVED_SERVICE' AND reserved_service_key = #{serviceKey} ORDER BY (client_status = 'ACTIVE') DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, client_id, secret_digest, created_at, valid_until, revoked_at FROM iam_oauth_client_secrets WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY created_at, id
SELECT id FROM iam_oauth_clients WHERE client_status = 'REVOKED' ORDER BY id
